clips.title: The story
paras: In Northshire Abbey, Brother Paxton needs fresh ink for his work as a monastic scribe. He sends you east to Lakeshire for Rethban ore, the mineral his fast-drying ink requires.

Brother Paxton takes pride in his craft and uses a special ink for important writings such as The Stresses of Iron. His recipe dries quickly and resists smearing, but the ink can dry in its pot if left too long. To make more, he needs raw Rethban iron ore, mined in the rocky Redridge Mountains.

Lakeshire has little room for a distant scribe’s request. Foreman Oslow oversees laborers busy strengthening barricades, rebuilding ruined structures, and defending the town from ongoing Blackrock orc raids. With no workers to spare for mining, travelers must seek the ore in the perilous Rethban Caverns themselves.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I've been meaning to finish my copy of The Stresses of Iron, but...

Well you see, I make my own ink for books I copy. It's my own recipe; it doesn't run or smear, and it dries very quickly Unfortunately, it dries too quickly! My last batch dried up before I could finish the copying job, and I haven't had the chance to make more ink!
To make more I need Rethban Iron Ore from the Redridge Mountains. Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire is my usual supplier.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You need what?? Maybe you haven't noticed, but we're busy fortifying Lakeshire's defenses and repairing damage from recent orc attacks. If you need Rethban Iron Ore, you'll have to get it yourself!
